title: Julio Iglesias accused of sexual assault as Spanish prosecutors study the allegations
summary: Spanish prosecutors are studying allegations that Grammy-winning singer Julio Iglesias sexually assaulted two former employees at his residences in the Dominican Republic and the Bahamas.

title: Scientists call another near-record hot year a 'warning shot' from a shifting climate
summary: Scientists calculate that last year was one of the three hottest on record, along with 2024 and 2023. The trend indicates that warming could be speeding up, climate monitoring teams reported.

title: Asda hit by debt sell-off after Christmas sales slump
summary: Traders offload retailer’s bonds and loans in a sign that confidence in the group’s turnaround is weakening

title: Cold Snap to Test Asia Weather Records as Temperatures Dive
summary: A blast of frigid Arctic air is set to sweep across Asia next week, pushing temperatures toward potentially record lows and likely boosting heating demand in key energy markets.
